name: Orange-Glazed Sweet Potatoes
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ cup firmly packed brown sugar

steps: Slice sweet potatoes about ⅛ inch thick and spread evenly in an 8-inch square baking dish.
Combine orange juice, brown sugar, wheat germ, margarine, orange peel, cinnamon and nutmeg in bowl.
Pour liquid mixture over the sweet potatoes.
Cover dish with foil or lid. Bake for 1 hour at 350°F until potatoes are tender.

culture.text: The potato is a starchy tuberous vegetable native to the Americas that is consumed as a staple food in many parts of the world. Potatoes are underground stem tubers of the plant Solanum tuberosum, a perennial in the nightshade family Solanaceae.
